title: Credential third-party issuance
why_second: the rail is inert, not dangerous - it refuses every revoke rather than performing a wrong one
open_question: RESOLVED (Phase 0, plan.md): who may issue a credential to another user is ROLE-GATED - dapp:manager role plus nft:mint scope, enforced in CredentialController.Issue. A recipient-consent-grant model was considered and deliberately deferred (owed, not dismissed).
acceptance_headline: issuer != holder on a real mint, and no path reports success without a confirmed broadcast
enforcement_gate: Enforcement now exists: Services/Actions/NotEnabledActionNodeTypes refuses CredentialRevoke at publish and at BOTH dispatch seams. Phases 0-3 (two-party mint, current_owner at mint, clawback preconditions, confirmation/ownership re-pointing) are landed per plan.md. Only Phase 4 remains: adversarial review, /security-review, then remove CredentialRevoke as the final step.
reconciled_2026_09_07: status moved from pending to in_progress and the open_question marked resolved, matching plan.md's own Phase 0-3 [x] checkboxes and verified against source (Controllers/CredentialController.cs Issue endpoint, Services/Reconciliation/ReconciliationService.cs D41/AC5 handling, tests/AZOA.WebAPI.Tests/Credentials/). Only Phase 4 remains open; status stays in_progress, not shipped, until it closes.
